text: {"entries":[{"name_han":"峨眉山志","logic_thesis":"Emei proves that sacred space is not scenery but a graded field of qi in which altitude, orientation, and cult succession encode a hierarchy of cultivation stages. What is recorded as history of halls and hermits is actually an argument that the mountain itself is a living body of Dao whose nodes must be entered in correct order.","logic_chain":"1) Premises: mountains concentrate heaven–earth qi; temples mark successful past intersections of that qi with human practice. 2) Inference: each peak, cave, and monastery on Emei is a functional organ of one continuum, not isolated wonder. 3) Inference: pilgrimage routes and transmission lineages map the same path from coarse to refined qi. 4) Inference: disorder of site (wrong hall, broken lineage) predicts disorder of practice. 5) Conclusion: reading the gazetteer is reading a spatial BaZi of the mountain—place-luck that can be aligned with personal chart timing.","logic_practice":"1) When a chart lacks mountain/earth support (weak土/印), treat Emei-type west-southwest high ground as corrective fengshui analog. 2) Stage practice like Emei’s layered temples: form → breath → emptiness, never skip levels. 3) Use ‘mountain opening’ years (strong 山/印 luck) for retreats, not for worldly expansion. 4) Map natal 驿马 and 华盖 to ‘pilgrimage nodes’—travel/retreat only when those stars are activated. 5) Record personal ‘temple nodes’ (places of breakthrough) as a private 山志 of your chart.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure geographic 地志, Emei’s logic is soteriological: place proves path. Unlike 崂山志’s Daoist hermitage focus, Emei braids Buddhist and Daoist qi into one graded field, so its lesson for BaZi is multi-school complementarity rather than single-lineage purity."},{"name_han":"衡岳志","logic_thesis":"Hengyue proves that the southern sacred mountain is a regulator of fire–life–fame cycles: the mountain’s ritual calendar and imperial sacrifice history argue that human destiny must be periodically recalibrated to southern fire’s seasonal law. The text’s real claim is that political and personal 运 rise and fall with correct offering to the fire-axis of the realm.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Nanyue is the southern pillar of the five-marchmount system, assigned fire and life-growth. 2) Inference: imperial and local rites are technologies for tuning collective and individual 火运. 3) Inference: neglect of the mountain’s calendar produces drought of both crops and career fire. 4) Inference: legends of immortals and recluses at Heng show successful personal attunement to that fire axis. 5) Conclusion: Hengyue is a proof-text that 火 in BaZi is not temperament only but a cosmological office requiring timed ritual and ethical heat.","logic_practice":"1) For charts with excessive or deficient 火, use Heng-logic: schedule major moves in 巳午未 or when 食伤/官杀 fire is supported, not random motivation. 2) Treat ‘southern career fame’ years as sacrifice years—give back (charity, teaching) to keep fire from burning the self. 3) If 印 is weak and fire harsh, cultivate ‘cloud-and-mist’ cooling practices (静坐, water/metal environments) as mountain-side balancing. 4) Align annual 太岁 visits or ancestral rites with the chart’s fire season. 5) Use Heng’s ‘pillar’ image: stabilize life structure before seeking fire renown.","logic_compare":"Where 峨眉山志 grades internal stages of ascent, 衡岳志 grades external cosmic office—fire as mandate. It differs from purely literary 志怪 by treating mountain ritual as state-and-body thermodynamics, closer to classical 五岳 cosmology than to ghost narrative."},{"name_han":"崂山志","logic_thesis":"Laoshan proves that coastal mountain qi produces a distinctive cultivation logic: interface of sea (坎水) and rock (艮山) yields longevity techniques, hermit sovereignty, and ‘immortal as local ecology.’ The gazetteer argues that true power is not court rank but successful long-term residence inside a self-sustaining qi niche.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Laoshan sits where ocean vapor meets mountain stone—water refining mountain, mountain containing water. 2) Inference: Daoist lineages there perfected internal alchemy as ecological adaptation, not abstract doctrine. 3) Inference: hermit biographies are experiments in niche-fit (right place × right practice × right time). 4) Inference: failure stories are mis-fits of body chart to place chart. 5) Conclusion: Laoshan demonstrates that BaZi must be read with 地理 as co-cause of destiny expression.","logic_practice":"1) For 金水 strong charts seeking 土固, prefer seaside-mountain or island retreats over pure desert dryness. 2) Build a ‘niche plan’: career/home that locks 比劫 resources like a hermitage locks grain and spring. 3) Use 沐浴/败 years for sea-side purification, not for launching empires. 4) When 华盖+空亡 appear, study Laoshan-style solitary skill mastery rather than social climbing. 5) Diagnose burnout as leaving one’s niche: return to place/practice that historically held your qi.","logic_compare":"Unlike 衡岳志’s imperial fire axis, 崂山志 centers hermit autonomy and water–mountain alchemy. Unlike 鹤鸣山志’s founding of Tianshi institutional Dao, Laoshan proves decentralized ecological sanctity—useful for personal BaZi niche design rather than lineage authority."},{"name_han":"齐云山志","logic_thesis":"Qiyun proves that a mountain can function as a complete ritual machine for destiny correction: cliff, cave, inscription, and liturgical calendar form a feedback system between human petition and cosmic response. The text’s argument is that visible landscape grammar (steepness, direction, named peaks) is readable syntax of yin–yang administration.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Qiyun’s Daoist complexes organize space as altar—ascent equals approach to decree. 2) Inference: steles and poems are not ornament but logged successful petitions (case law of 感应). 3) Inference: geometric features of the mountain encode binary oppositions usable in diagnosis (open/closed, high/low, yin cave/yang cliff). 4) Inference: personal timing must match the mountain’s festival and weather rhythms to ‘submit a valid brief.’ 5) Conclusion: place is a court; BaZi is the case file; ritual timing is filing procedure.","logic_practice":"1) Before major 改运 actions (move, marriage, business), stage a symbolic ‘ascent’: progressive purification over days matching your useful gods. 2) Read home/office layout as Qiyun grammar—blockages as sealed caves, excess openness as lost 气. 3) Time petitions (applications, lawsuits, vows) to days when chart 用神 is strong, as if matching a liturgical hour. 4) Keep a stele-like journal of 感应 outcomes to refine personal case law. 5) Use cliff/cave dual practice: yang action periods vs yin storage periods in the luck cycle.","logic_compare":"Qiyun differs from Emei’s graded Buddhist–Daoist soteriology by emphasizing petition–response mechanics. It is less ecological than Laoshan and more juridical: mountain as yamen of Heaven, ideal for BaZi questions about 官杀, lawsuits, and formal destiny correction."},{"name_han":"鹤鸣山志","logic_thesis":"Heming Mountain proves that institutional Dao and personal mandate co-originate in a single revelatory site: Zhang Daoling’s covenant shows that correct place + correct time + correct moral-legal pact can rewrite a lineage’s and a region’s 运. The gazetteer’s core argument is that ‘teaching’ is a cosmological contract, not mere doctrine.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Heming is the locus where celestial law was downloaded into human administration (天师道). 2) Inference: revelation requires a mountain node capable of carrying 盟约 (oath) charge. 3) Inference: subsequent history of the site tests whether later generations keep the contract’s ethical terms. 4) Inference: decline of site power tracks breach of covenant more than loss of tourism. 5) Conclusion: BaZi and cultivation succeed when life is run as a kept oath with Heaven’s pattern, anchored in concrete place and calendar.","logic_practice":"1) Identify your chart’s ‘covenant gods’ (正官, 印, 食神 as vow-keepers) and design non-negotiable daily rules around them. 2) Found personal ‘teaching’ only in years when 官印 are illuminated—Heming logic forbids launching lineage in chaotic 伤官见官 years without mediation. 3) Use written vows (戒) timed to 甲子 or personal 元堂 days as qi locks. 4) If 七杀 is strong, convert it to 食神制杀 service roles rather than raw force—Tianshi administrative model. 5) Periodically ‘return to the mountain’ (retreat to origin method) when luck pillars change to re-ratify the contract.","logic_compare":"Unlike scenic or multi-cult 山志, 鹤鸣山志 is a founding charter: it proves institutional transmission as cosmological engineering. Compared with 封神演义’s mass investiture fantasy, Heming is historical-covenantal and minimal: one site, one pact, lasting law—closer to BaZi’s ‘立极’ than to novelistic theomachy."},{"name_han":"子不语","logic_thesis":"Yuan Mei’s collection proves by accumulation that the strange is ordinary data: refusing to speak of 怪力乱神 does not abolish their causal patterns; it only blinds the moral scientist. The book’s argument is empiricist: countless small cases show retribution, attachment, and qi-anomaly as repeatable mechanisms, not superstition.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Confucian silence about the strange is pedagogical, not ontological denial. 2) Inference: carefully recorded anomalies form a dataset of hidden law. 3) Inference: patterns of 报应, lust, fear, and place-ghosts recur across regions and ranks. 4) Inference: skepticism that refuses cases is less rational than skepticism that classifies them. 5) Conclusion: destiny analysis must include ‘anomalous’ events as valid chart-expression evidence.","logic_practice":"1) Log life’s odd coincidences against luck pillar changes; treat them as data, not noise. 2) When 官杀 or 桃花 years bring haunt-like relationship chaos, apply 子不语 hygiene: reduce lust/fear fuel before blaming spirits. 3) Use case-comparison: similar chart patterns → similar anomaly classes (illness ghost, debt ghost, place ghost). 4) Practice speech discipline: speak of the strange only to classify and correct, never to sensationalize (Yuan’s ironic method). 5) Strengthen 印 and 食伤 as ‘recording faculties’—clarity of narrative is cultivation.","logic_compare":"Unlike 聊斋志异’s aesthetic sympathy for fox and ghost subjectivity, 子不语 is cooler, case-file rationalism. Unlike 阅微草堂笔记’s heavier moral-jurisprudence of Heaven, Yuan Mei often punctures pedantry—closer to forensic BaZi than to didactic sermon."},{"name_han":"阅微草堂笔记","logic_thesis":"Ji Yun proves that the spirit world is a mirror court of human ethics: supernatural episodes are admissible evidence in a continuous jurisprudence from family to underworld to Heaven. The core argument is that 理 is one; ghost stories are case law illustrating how intention, office, and debt transfer across visible and invisible registers.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Qing bureaucratic and Confucian reason can extend to yin bureaucracy without contradiction. 2) Inference: each tale is a judgment sample on 因果, not entertainment. 3) Inference: office (名分), sincerity (诚), and clever casuistry produce different postmortem outcomes. 4) Inference: over-clever human lawyering fails when it violates deeper 理. 5) Conclusion: BaZi ‘gods’ (官杀印食) are role-offices whose ethical use determines whether luck becomes blessing or indictment.","logic_practice":"1) Read annual 官杀 as court terms: act as if files are open—document honesty in contracts. 2) In 伤官 years, avoid sophistic self-justification; Ji Yun repeatedly punishes clever cruelty. 3) Settle debts (money, apology, unfinished duty) before 大运 shifts that activate 财/官. 4) Cultivate 正印: study and restraint as filing correct briefs with Heaven. 5) Use dream/omen reports only after ethical audit—content is secondary to conscience state.","logic_compare":"Harder-edged than 聊斋’s romance of the other; more systematically moral-rational than 子不语’s amused empiricism. For BaZi, 阅微 is the textbook of 官杀 as justice process, not mere pressure or career."},{"name_han":"聊斋志异","logic_thesis":"Pu Songling proves that boundary beings (fox, ghost, immortal) externalize repressed structure in the human chart: desire, injustice, and unrecognized talent take nonhuman form to complete exchanges blocked by social law. The argument is that 情 is a cosmological force that can rewrite fate when 理 alone is corrupt or incomplete.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: human institutions misallocate recognition (才, 情, 冤). 2) Inference: surplus qi seeks alternate bodies and nights to finish its circuit. 3) Inference: successful human–other unions follow rules of sincerity, courage, and timed separation/return. 4) Inference: tragedy follows treating the other as pure instrument of lust or status. 5) Conclusion: fate is negotiable at the emotion–spirit interface if exchange ethics hold.","logic_practice":"1) Strong 桃花/食伤 charts: practice 聊斋 ethics—reciprocity and clear boundaries with charismatic others. 2) 伤官佩印 strategy: art and feeling need a container (印) or they spawn ‘fox chaos.’ 3) Use night/rest hours for creative 通灵 work; day for social 理—honor the dual schedule. 4) In injustice years (七杀无制), seek lawful redress first; only then symbolic or spiritual closure. 5) Marriage/合盘: check whether the bond completes missing 用神 or only feeds 忌神 addiction.","logic_compare":"Opposite pole to 阅微’s courtroom: 聊斋 prioritizes 情 as corrective metaphysics. Unlike 封神’s hierarchical investiture, change here is intimate and bilateral—ideal for relationship BaZi and 桃花 cultivation ethics."},{"name_han":"搜神后记","logic_thesis":"As sequel logic to earlier 搜神 tradition, this text proves continuity of a catalog method: the cosmos remains populated and patterned after classical high antiquity; later ages still harvest verifiable spirit-events. Its argument is that the sacred inventory did not close—methodology of recording is itself a form of keeping Heaven–human channels open.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: earlier 搜神 established that spirits are reportable facts. 2) Inference: a ‘后记’ asserts non-exhaustion of that field. 3) Inference: new cases under new dynastic conditions show invariant mechanisms (transformation, gratitude, warning). 4) Inference: transmission of records is cultivation of collective memory-qi. 5) Conclusion: BaZi practice needs ongoing case-logging; classical categories stay live if fed with present evidence.","logic_practice":"1) Maintain a personal 搜神: date-stamped events linked to 流年 stems/branches. 2) Classify anomalies with classical tags (物怪, 复生, 仙隐) to see which chart factors recur. 3) Treat ‘sequel’ years (second chance, return of ex, relapse) as 后记 structure—same pattern, new chapter. 4) Study gratitude-and-warning tales as models for 印星 response to help received. 5) Do not assume modern disenchantment; test categories empirically.","logic_compare":"Less literary than 聊斋, less encyclopedic than 太平广记: it is methodological continuation. For BaZi, its value is discipline of serial evidence, not novelistic depth or imperial scale."},{"name_han":"太平广记","logic_thesis":"Taiping Guangji proves by encyclopedic scale that typology is power: when thousands of strange cases are sorted into categories (immortals, dragons, regenerations, dreams…), chaos becomes a searchable map of causal genres. The argument is taxonomic: destiny problems are misclassified problems; correct genre yields correct remedy.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: raw wonder without sorting overwhelms judgment. 2) Inference: Song compilation impulse is a cognitive-alchemical act—distill multiplicity into types. 3) Inference: each type implies signature causes and interventions. 4) Inference: cross-type confusion (treating a debt-ghost as a pure romance-fox) fails. 5) Conclusion: BaZi master-work is the same as 广记 work—classify chart phenomena into operative genres before acting.","logic_practice":"1) Build a personal typology table: career blocks, health flares, relationship loops mapped to 十神 patterns. 2) When crisis hits, first ask ‘which 广记 category?’ then ‘which useful god?’ 3) Study one category deeply per 大运 phase rather than dabbling. 4) Use encyclopedic humility: rare patterns exist—don’t force every case into favorite theory. 5) Index dreams, omens, and illnesses separately; look for crossover only after pure types are clear.","logic_compare":"Unlike single-author 笔记 with voice and verdict, 太平广记 is imperial archive logic—breadth over persona. Unlike 封神’s unified mythic plot, it refuses one story; its gift to BaZi is classification science."},{"name_han":"稽神录","logic_thesis":"Xu Xuan’s records prove a transitional epistemology: early Song still treats spirit reports as politically and personally actionable intelligence, yet with archival sobriety. The argument is that 稽 (‘examine/investigate’) is the proper verb—spirits are not banned or romanticized but audited.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: title itself mandates investigation, not credulity or scoffing. 2) Inference: short entries model minimal sufficient evidence for a claim about the unseen. 3) Inference: many cases tie anomaly to office, travel, and local cult—public coordinates. 4) Inference: examination yields probabilistic guidance, not absolute oracle. 5) Conclusion: BaZi consultation should inherit 稽神 method—investigate, cite, limit claims.","logic_practice":"1) For each forecast, state evidence tier (natal only / natal+event / natal+event+place). 2) Prefer short, testable predictions like 稽神 entries; review hit rate. 3) Investigate local 神 and 煞 of a client’s residence as co-factors. 4) In 官运, treat omens as administrative alerts—verify, then act. 5) Drop narratives that cannot be audited; silence is better than ornate error.","logic_compare":"Drier than 玄怪录’s artful strangeness and leaner than 太平广记’s omnibus. It stands closest to professional ethics for diviners: examine spirits as one examines documents."},{"name_han":"封神演义","logic_thesis":"Investiture of the Gods proves that history’s slaughter is secretly a staffing process for the celestial bureaucracy: death and defeat are recruitment under a higher table of organization. The core argument is that 命 is an appointment list; cultivation and loyalty determine which office one is ‘封’ into after role-death in the human drama.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Zhou’s rise needs not only arms but a reordered pantheon. 2) Inference: each warrior’s death is dual—military loss and metaphysical posting. 3) Inference: sect affiliation (Chan vs Jie) dramatizes competing cosmologies of inclusion and excess. 4) Inference: broken oaths and cruel techniques produce cursed appointments. 5) Conclusion: BaZi 官杀 and 神煞 are pre-traces of the office one is training for—ethics decide the post’s quality.","logic_practice":"1) Read 七杀 as raw commission: with 食神/制, it becomes legitimate 偏官 service; without, massacre destiny. 2) In conflict years, ask ‘what office is this death-of-role creating?’ (career exit as investiture). 3) Avoid 封神-style 左道 techniques (shortcut magic) when 伤官 is hot—cost is later binding. 4) Align vows and team loyalty with 比劫/正官 structure; betrayal patterns match novel’s doomed factions. 5) Use ritual closure after major life ‘battles’ so qi posts correctly rather than wandering as resentful 煞.","logic_compare":"Unlike 山志’s place-based sanctity, 封神 is personnel cosmology on civilizational scale. Unlike 济公全传’s trickster compassion, it is hierarchical and martial—best for modeling 官杀 hierarchy, not intimate ethics."},{"name_han":"三遂平妖传","logic_thesis":"The novel proves that heterodox arts plus social grievance produce ‘妖’ as a political-qi epidemic: magic is real as technique, but without legitimate 正 order it amplifies chaos until systematically dismantled. The argument is diagnostic—identify the technique, the grievance fuel, and the correct team of counter-practitioners (the three Sui).","logic_chain":"1) Premise: forbidden arts circulate among the desperate and ambitious. 2) Inference: personal grievance is the fire under magical rebellion. 3) Inference: spectacle magic fools crowds by hijacking 食伤/财 attention. 4) Inference: only coordinated, rightly timed counter-skill (not mere force) restores order. 5) Conclusion: BaZi crises that look ‘demonic’ are often technique + fuel + mis-timed response; cure is triad: clarity, timing, ethical force.","logic_practice":"1) When chart shows 伤官 + 偏财 + 劫煞 chaos, audit for ‘heterodox shortcuts’ (scams, cults, stimulant lifestyles). 2) Separate fuel (怨) from technique (巧); heal grievance before fighting symptoms. 3) Build a ‘三遂 team’: one analyst (印), one doer (比劫/食), one ritual/behavioral boundary (官). 4) Time crackdowns on bad habits to 官杀 useful periods, not to 桃花 high. 5) After quelling, reinvest energy into legitimate craft—empty hands refill with 妖 if idle.","logic_compare":"More sociological than 封神’s celestial HR; more cautionary than 女仙外史’s sometimes glorified rebellion. For cultivation, it is the manual of anti-left-path hygiene and collective counter-practice."},{"name_han":"济公全传","logic_thesis":"Ji Gong’s saga proves that realized mind can wear pollution as camouflage: true function is 游戏三昧—saving beings through apparent violation of form. The argument is that attachment to pure appearance is itself a demon; compassion plus skillful means outranks cosmetic precept.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: late institutional religion confuses robe and realization. 2) Inference: a living arhat may invert signs (wine, meat, madness) to bypass ego of pure and impure. 3) Inference: miracles follow need, not display schedule. 4) Inference: those who cling to surface purity miss the living Buddha and keep their 障. 5) Conclusion: in BaZi/cultivation, useful god operation may look ‘wrong’ to rigid school-forms yet be correct for the chart’s actual 病药.","logic_practice":"1) Identify where your ‘precept’ is actually 印星 vanity; test whether breaking a minor form enables greater 食神 service. 2) Strong 七杀/伤官: channel Ji Gong—disruptive behavior only when it protects beings, never as self-indulgence. 3) Practice 游戏: lightness in 比劫 conflicts reduces 煞. 4) Charity and rescue actions in 财/官 years without branding them as spiritual capital. 5) Teachers: judge by liberation effect, not by costume—apply same to your own public image.","logic_compare":"Inverts 封神’s formal pantheon and 阅微’s bureaucratic moralism: holiness as clown. Unlike 南游记’s fierce deity careerism, Ji Gong is downward-mobile compassion—key for charts that must use ‘impure’ careers as 用神."},{"name_han":"南游记","logic_thesis":"Journey to the South proves a deity-career logic: Huaguang’s violent, multi-birth path shows that fierce 火 nature must complete karma through successive role-embodiments before stabilizing as a recognized protector. The argument is developmental—wrath is not deleted but promoted through ordeal into office.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: certain spirits/persons are constitutionally fierce fire. 2) Inference: suppression without transformation only relocates disaster across rebirths/roles. 3) Inference: each episode (conflict with Heaven, descent, redemption) is a promotion exam. 4) Inference: final cult recognition ratifies successful sublimation of wrath into protection. 5) Conclusion: BaZi strong 七杀/伤官/fire is a multi-stage career of the god within—design ordeals as exams, not as random suffering.","logic_practice":"1) Map 大运 as Huaguang chapters: outlaw phase → contested phase → protector phase. 2) Never aim to ‘extinguish’ useful 杀; aim to 食神制杀 or 杀印相生 sublimation. 3) Use southern/fire industries carefully as proper temple for such charts. 4) Ritualize apology and repair after wrath episodes—speed promotion to protector role. 5) Avoid premature self-canonization; recognition comes after ordeal completion.","logic_compare":"Sibling to 封神’s investiture but focused on one deity’s Bildungsroman of fire. Less comic than 济公, less feminist-rebellious than 女仙外史—pure template for fierce-chart career alchemy."},{"name_han":"女仙外史","logic_thesis":"This novel proves that dynastic injustice can legitimate a counter-mandate led by feminine immortal power: Tang Sai’er’s uprising is framed as 天道 correcting 人道 when the throne violates cosmic equity. The argument is that yin authority is not secondary; under specific historical-qi conditions it becomes the main corrective axis.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Ming founding violence and misrule create surplus 冤. 2) Inference: surplus seeks a carrier; feminine immortal lineage supplies form. 3) Inference: rebellion is rewritten as eschatological repair, not mere banditry. 4) Inference: literary 外史 asserts truth outside official history’s monopoly. 5) Conclusion: BaZi must allow 阴用神 and ‘unofficial’ paths when official 官 structures are corrupt relative to the chart’s mandate.","logic_practice":"1) For 阴干 useful-god charts (especially 乙己丁癸 strong), do not force purely yang career molds. 2) When 官 is 忌神, ‘外史 path’—independent enterprise, alternative institutions—may be correct 运. 3) Channel grievance into structured 七杀 use with 印/食, not pure 劫财 revolt. 4) Study timing of collective movements only if personal chart has 驿马+杀+义; else cultivate local repair. 5) Honor 女仙 logic: protect the vulnerable as the way yin mandate proves itself.","logic_compare":"More politically inverted than 封神’s eventual orthodox Zhou order; more sustained ideological rebellion than 三遂’s anti-妖 quelling. For BaZi, it theorizes legitimate anti-structure when structure is the disease."},{"name_han":"玄怪录","logic_thesis":"Niu Sengru’s tales prove that the ‘mysterious’ is a narrative technology for testing elite moral imagination: encounters with the strange measure whether the official mind can remain humane under ontological shock. The argument is that 玄 is a training environment for judgment, not a catalog of tricks.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Tang literati subjectivity is the true protagonist. 2) Inference: ghost/immortal plots are simulators for virtue under uncertainty. 3) Inference: aesthetic control of strangeness disciplines fear and desire. 4) Inference: those who respond with ritual correctness plus human warmth pass. 5) Conclusion: BaZi counseling and self-cultivation need 玄怪 capacity—hold unknown variables without collapsing into panic or greed.","logic_practice":"1) In 空亡/华盖 years, practice sitting with uncertainty as 玄 training. 2) When forecasts conflict, keep dual hypotheses like a well-told 怪 tale—update on evidence. 3) Use elegant restraint in speech about destiny (literati craft as 食神). 4) Test moral response to sudden chart-events before optimizing tactics. 5) Read one classical anomaly tale when 七杀 hits—train nervous system on safe strange.","logic_compare":"More artful and elite-psychological than 稽神录’s audit prose; less encyclopedic than 太平广记; less Qing-moralist than 阅微. It is cultivation of cognitive poise for diviners and officials."},{"name_han":"异苑","logic_thesis":"Liu Jingshu proves that marvels are local ecology: the ‘garden’ metaphor argues for curated diversity of anomalies as a natural history of the weird. The core claim is that strangeness is regional and species-like—each biome of qi grows characteristic 异.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: Six Dynasties curiosity treats anomaly as collectible natural fact. 2) Inference: arranging marvels as a garden implies typology by habitat. 3) Inference: human fate is partly which garden one lives in (place-species of event). 4) Inference: transplanting without care (wrong move, wrong cult) kills or mutates the pattern. 5) Conclusion: BaZi expressions are habitat-relative; same chart, different 异苑.","logic_practice":"1) When relocating, predict which anomaly/opportunity species the new region favors for your useful gods. 2) Build a ‘garden’ of micro-practices suited to local climate and culture. 3) Do not universalize one region’s ghost/luck lore onto another chart without place adjustment. 4) Collect small verified local patterns as Liu collected 异. 5) Prune toxic marvels (sensational media, fear cults) like weeding the garden.","logic_compare":"Earlier, shorter, more natural-historical than Qing 笔记 moral courts; less romantic than 聊斋. Its unique gift is habitat logic—BaZi × regional 风土."},{"name_han":"夜谭随录","logic_thesis":"He Bang’e proves that night conversation is a legitimate epistemic mode: what cannot be certified at noon may still be true as 夜-pattern, when yin faculties dominate. The argument is that timing of knowing matters—some causal structures only disclose under yin conditions.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: title frames knowledge as evening talk, not daylight memorial. 2) Inference: narrative sociality (talk) midwifes spirit truth. 3) Inference: night is when 阴神 and dream logic share continuum with waking residue. 4) Inference: recording night-talks preserves half of human data usually discarded. 5) Conclusion: BaZi must schedule analysis and cultivation across yin–yang hours; exclusive daylight rationalism truncates the chart.","logic_practice":"1) Do dream/journal review in 亥子丑; do contracts and surgery timing logic in yang hours. 2) Strong 水/印 charts: honor night study; strong 火 charts: limit night talk to avoid 耗. 3) Use conversation with trusted peers as 夜谭 method for hard chart puzzles. 4) Track which 流日 branches bring usable night signals. 5) Avoid deciding major yang-world moves solely on nocturnal emotion peaks.","logic_compare":"Closer to social storytelling than 阅微’s judgment seat; less polished fame than 聊斋 but clearer about the epistemology of night. It uniquely theorizes when knowledge is valid—critical for 择时."},{"name_han":"宣室志","logic_thesis":"Zhang Du’s work, named for the Han hall where Emperor Wen heard Jia Yi on ghosts and spirits, proves that ruler-level policy conversation must include the unseen as risk and resource. The argument is that political rationality incomplete without 神道 data is false thrift of attention.","logic_chain":"1) Premise: historical 宣室 dialogue models elite seriousness about spirits. 2) Inference: Tang tales under that title inherit the duty to advise power about yin causes. 3) Inference: personal stories scale to state analogy—household disorder mirrors realm disorder. 4) Inference: proper hearing (listening without panic or ridicule) is the first ritual of governance. 5) Conclusion: BaZi for leaders and self-leaders is 宣室 practice—hear the invisible factors before issuing orders to life.","logic_practice":"1) Before yearly planning, hold a personal 宣室: review omens, health, ethics, and chart 忌神 as cabinet reports. 2) Leaders: treat team ‘ghosts’ (burnout, rumor, silent resentment) as real 阴 factors. 3) Cultivate listening virtue (印) equal to decisive 杀. 4) Separate Jia Yi-style analytic speech about spirits from vulgar fearmongering. 5) After decisions, audit unseen side-effects as Zhang Du’s cases would.","logic_compare":"More explicitly political-classical in frame than most 志怪; less comic-folk than 济公, less romantic than 聊斋. It is the template for integrating spirit-causality into high-level timing and governance of one’s fate."}]}

entries.logic_thesis: Emei proves that sacred space is not scenery but a graded field of qi in which altitude, orientation, and cult succession encode a hierarchy of cultivation stages. What is recorded as history of halls and hermits is actually an argument that the mountain itself is a living body of Dao whose nodes must be entered in correct order.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premises: mountains concentrate heaven–earth qi; temples mark successful past intersections of that qi with human practice. 2) Inference: each peak, cave, and monastery on Emei is a functional organ of one continuum, not isolated wonder. 3) Inference: pilgrimage routes and transmission lineages map the same path from coarse to refined qi. 4) Inference: disorder of site (wrong hall, broken lineage) predicts disorder of practice. 5) Conclusion: reading the gazetteer is reading a spatial BaZi of the mountain—place-luck that can be aligned with personal chart timing.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When a chart lacks mountain/earth support (weak土/印), treat Emei-type west-southwest high ground as corrective fengshui analog. 2) Stage practice like Emei’s layered temples: form → breath → emptiness, never skip levels. 3) Use ‘mountain opening’ years (strong 山/印 luck) for retreats, not for worldly expansion. 4) Map natal 驿马 and 华盖 to ‘pilgrimage nodes’—travel/retreat only when those stars are activated. 5) Record personal ‘temple nodes’ (places of breakthrough) as a private 山志 of your chart.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure geographic 地志, Emei’s logic is soteriological: place proves path. Unlike 崂山志’s Daoist hermitage focus, Emei braids Buddhist and Daoist qi into one graded field, so its lesson for BaZi is multi-school complementarity rather than single-lineage purity.

entries.logic_thesis: Hengyue proves that the southern sacred mountain is a regulator of fire–life–fame cycles: the mountain’s ritual calendar and imperial sacrifice history argue that human destiny must be periodically recalibrated to southern fire’s seasonal law. The text’s real claim is that political and personal 运 rise and fall with correct offering to the fire-axis of the realm.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Nanyue is the southern pillar of the five-marchmount system, assigned fire and life-growth. 2) Inference: imperial and local rites are technologies for tuning collective and individual 火运. 3) Inference: neglect of the mountain’s calendar produces drought of both crops and career fire. 4) Inference: legends of immortals and recluses at Heng show successful personal attunement to that fire axis. 5) Conclusion: Hengyue is a proof-text that 火 in BaZi is not temperament only but a cosmological office requiring timed ritual and ethical heat.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For charts with excessive or deficient 火, use Heng-logic: schedule major moves in 巳午未 or when 食伤/官杀 fire is supported, not random motivation. 2) Treat ‘southern career fame’ years as sacrifice years—give back (charity, teaching) to keep fire from burning the self. 3) If 印 is weak and fire harsh, cultivate ‘cloud-and-mist’ cooling practices (静坐, water/metal environments) as mountain-side balancing. 4) Align annual 太岁 visits or ancestral rites with the chart’s fire season. 5) Use Heng’s ‘pillar’ image: stabilize life structure before seeking fire renown.
entries.logic_compare: Where 峨眉山志 grades internal stages of ascent, 衡岳志 grades external cosmic office—fire as mandate. It differs from purely literary 志怪 by treating mountain ritual as state-and-body thermodynamics, closer to classical 五岳 cosmology than to ghost narrative.

entries.logic_thesis: Laoshan proves that coastal mountain qi produces a distinctive cultivation logic: interface of sea (坎水) and rock (艮山) yields longevity techniques, hermit sovereignty, and ‘immortal as local ecology.’ The gazetteer argues that true power is not court rank but successful long-term residence inside a self-sustaining qi niche.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Laoshan sits where ocean vapor meets mountain stone—water refining mountain, mountain containing water. 2) Inference: Daoist lineages there perfected internal alchemy as ecological adaptation, not abstract doctrine. 3) Inference: hermit biographies are experiments in niche-fit (right place × right practice × right time). 4) Inference: failure stories are mis-fits of body chart to place chart. 5) Conclusion: Laoshan demonstrates that BaZi must be read with 地理 as co-cause of destiny expression.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For 金水 strong charts seeking 土固, prefer seaside-mountain or island retreats over pure desert dryness. 2) Build a ‘niche plan’: career/home that locks 比劫 resources like a hermitage locks grain and spring. 3) Use 沐浴/败 years for sea-side purification, not for launching empires. 4) When 华盖+空亡 appear, study Laoshan-style solitary skill mastery rather than social climbing. 5) Diagnose burnout as leaving one’s niche: return to place/practice that historically held your qi.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 衡岳志’s imperial fire axis, 崂山志 centers hermit autonomy and water–mountain alchemy. Unlike 鹤鸣山志’s founding of Tianshi institutional Dao, Laoshan proves decentralized ecological sanctity—useful for personal BaZi niche design rather than lineage authority.

entries.logic_thesis: Qiyun proves that a mountain can function as a complete ritual machine for destiny correction: cliff, cave, inscription, and liturgical calendar form a feedback system between human petition and cosmic response. The text’s argument is that visible landscape grammar (steepness, direction, named peaks) is readable syntax of yin–yang administration.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Qiyun’s Daoist complexes organize space as altar—ascent equals approach to decree. 2) Inference: steles and poems are not ornament but logged successful petitions (case law of 感应). 3) Inference: geometric features of the mountain encode binary oppositions usable in diagnosis (open/closed, high/low, yin cave/yang cliff). 4) Inference: personal timing must match the mountain’s festival and weather rhythms to ‘submit a valid brief.’ 5) Conclusion: place is a court; BaZi is the case file; ritual timing is filing procedure.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before major 改运 actions (move, marriage, business), stage a symbolic ‘ascent’: progressive purification over days matching your useful gods. 2) Read home/office layout as Qiyun grammar—blockages as sealed caves, excess openness as lost 气. 3) Time petitions (applications, lawsuits, vows) to days when chart 用神 is strong, as if matching a liturgical hour. 4) Keep a stele-like journal of 感应 outcomes to refine personal case law. 5) Use cliff/cave dual practice: yang action periods vs yin storage periods in the luck cycle.
entries.logic_compare: Qiyun differs from Emei’s graded Buddhist–Daoist soteriology by emphasizing petition–response mechanics. It is less ecological than Laoshan and more juridical: mountain as yamen of Heaven, ideal for BaZi questions about 官杀, lawsuits, and formal destiny correction.

entries.logic_thesis: Heming Mountain proves that institutional Dao and personal mandate co-originate in a single revelatory site: Zhang Daoling’s covenant shows that correct place + correct time + correct moral-legal pact can rewrite a lineage’s and a region’s 运. The gazetteer’s core argument is that ‘teaching’ is a cosmological contract, not mere doctrine.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Heming is the locus where celestial law was downloaded into human administration (天师道). 2) Inference: revelation requires a mountain node capable of carrying 盟约 (oath) charge. 3) Inference: subsequent history of the site tests whether later generations keep the contract’s ethical terms. 4) Inference: decline of site power tracks breach of covenant more than loss of tourism. 5) Conclusion: BaZi and cultivation succeed when life is run as a kept oath with Heaven’s pattern, anchored in concrete place and calendar.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Identify your chart’s ‘covenant gods’ (正官, 印, 食神 as vow-keepers) and design non-negotiable daily rules around them. 2) Found personal ‘teaching’ only in years when 官印 are illuminated—Heming logic forbids launching lineage in chaotic 伤官见官 years without mediation. 3) Use written vows (戒) timed to 甲子 or personal 元堂 days as qi locks. 4) If 七杀 is strong, convert it to 食神制杀 service roles rather than raw force—Tianshi administrative model. 5) Periodically ‘return to the mountain’ (retreat to origin method) when luck pillars change to re-ratify the contract.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike scenic or multi-cult 山志, 鹤鸣山志 is a founding charter: it proves institutional transmission as cosmological engineering. Compared with 封神演义’s mass investiture fantasy, Heming is historical-covenantal and minimal: one site, one pact, lasting law—closer to BaZi’s ‘立极’ than to novelistic theomachy.

entries.logic_thesis: Yuan Mei’s collection proves by accumulation that the strange is ordinary data: refusing to speak of 怪力乱神 does not abolish their causal patterns; it only blinds the moral scientist. The book’s argument is empiricist: countless small cases show retribution, attachment, and qi-anomaly as repeatable mechanisms, not superstition.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Confucian silence about the strange is pedagogical, not ontological denial. 2) Inference: carefully recorded anomalies form a dataset of hidden law. 3) Inference: patterns of 报应, lust, fear, and place-ghosts recur across regions and ranks. 4) Inference: skepticism that refuses cases is less rational than skepticism that classifies them. 5) Conclusion: destiny analysis must include ‘anomalous’ events as valid chart-expression evidence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Log life’s odd coincidences against luck pillar changes; treat them as data, not noise. 2) When 官杀 or 桃花 years bring haunt-like relationship chaos, apply 子不语 hygiene: reduce lust/fear fuel before blaming spirits. 3) Use case-comparison: similar chart patterns → similar anomaly classes (illness ghost, debt ghost, place ghost). 4) Practice speech discipline: speak of the strange only to classify and correct, never to sensationalize (Yuan’s ironic method). 5) Strengthen 印 and 食伤 as ‘recording faculties’—clarity of narrative is cultivation.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 聊斋志异’s aesthetic sympathy for fox and ghost subjectivity, 子不语 is cooler, case-file rationalism. Unlike 阅微草堂笔记’s heavier moral-jurisprudence of Heaven, Yuan Mei often punctures pedantry—closer to forensic BaZi than to didactic sermon.

entries.logic_thesis: Ji Yun proves that the spirit world is a mirror court of human ethics: supernatural episodes are admissible evidence in a continuous jurisprudence from family to underworld to Heaven. The core argument is that 理 is one; ghost stories are case law illustrating how intention, office, and debt transfer across visible and invisible registers.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Qing bureaucratic and Confucian reason can extend to yin bureaucracy without contradiction. 2) Inference: each tale is a judgment sample on 因果, not entertainment. 3) Inference: office (名分), sincerity (诚), and clever casuistry produce different postmortem outcomes. 4) Inference: over-clever human lawyering fails when it violates deeper 理. 5) Conclusion: BaZi ‘gods’ (官杀印食) are role-offices whose ethical use determines whether luck becomes blessing or indictment.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read annual 官杀 as court terms: act as if files are open—document honesty in contracts. 2) In 伤官 years, avoid sophistic self-justification; Ji Yun repeatedly punishes clever cruelty. 3) Settle debts (money, apology, unfinished duty) before 大运 shifts that activate 财/官. 4) Cultivate 正印: study and restraint as filing correct briefs with Heaven. 5) Use dream/omen reports only after ethical audit—content is secondary to conscience state.
entries.logic_compare: Harder-edged than 聊斋’s romance of the other; more systematically moral-rational than 子不语’s amused empiricism. For BaZi, 阅微 is the textbook of 官杀 as justice process, not mere pressure or career.

entries.logic_thesis: Pu Songling proves that boundary beings (fox, ghost, immortal) externalize repressed structure in the human chart: desire, injustice, and unrecognized talent take nonhuman form to complete exchanges blocked by social law. The argument is that 情 is a cosmological force that can rewrite fate when 理 alone is corrupt or incomplete.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: human institutions misallocate recognition (才, 情, 冤). 2) Inference: surplus qi seeks alternate bodies and nights to finish its circuit. 3) Inference: successful human–other unions follow rules of sincerity, courage, and timed separation/return. 4) Inference: tragedy follows treating the other as pure instrument of lust or status. 5) Conclusion: fate is negotiable at the emotion–spirit interface if exchange ethics hold.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Strong 桃花/食伤 charts: practice 聊斋 ethics—reciprocity and clear boundaries with charismatic others. 2) 伤官佩印 strategy: art and feeling need a container (印) or they spawn ‘fox chaos.’ 3) Use night/rest hours for creative 通灵 work; day for social 理—honor the dual schedule. 4) In injustice years (七杀无制), seek lawful redress first; only then symbolic or spiritual closure. 5) Marriage/合盘: check whether the bond completes missing 用神 or only feeds 忌神 addiction.
entries.logic_compare: Opposite pole to 阅微’s courtroom: 聊斋 prioritizes 情 as corrective metaphysics. Unlike 封神’s hierarchical investiture, change here is intimate and bilateral—ideal for relationship BaZi and 桃花 cultivation ethics.

entries.logic_thesis: As sequel logic to earlier 搜神 tradition, this text proves continuity of a catalog method: the cosmos remains populated and patterned after classical high antiquity; later ages still harvest verifiable spirit-events. Its argument is that the sacred inventory did not close—methodology of recording is itself a form of keeping Heaven–human channels open.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: earlier 搜神 established that spirits are reportable facts. 2) Inference: a ‘后记’ asserts non-exhaustion of that field. 3) Inference: new cases under new dynastic conditions show invariant mechanisms (transformation, gratitude, warning). 4) Inference: transmission of records is cultivation of collective memory-qi. 5) Conclusion: BaZi practice needs ongoing case-logging; classical categories stay live if fed with present evidence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Maintain a personal 搜神: date-stamped events linked to 流年 stems/branches. 2) Classify anomalies with classical tags (物怪, 复生, 仙隐) to see which chart factors recur. 3) Treat ‘sequel’ years (second chance, return of ex, relapse) as 后记 structure—same pattern, new chapter. 4) Study gratitude-and-warning tales as models for 印星 response to help received. 5) Do not assume modern disenchantment; test categories empirically.
entries.logic_compare: Less literary than 聊斋, less encyclopedic than 太平广记: it is methodological continuation. For BaZi, its value is discipline of serial evidence, not novelistic depth or imperial scale.

entries.logic_thesis: Taiping Guangji proves by encyclopedic scale that typology is power: when thousands of strange cases are sorted into categories (immortals, dragons, regenerations, dreams…), chaos becomes a searchable map of causal genres. The argument is taxonomic: destiny problems are misclassified problems; correct genre yields correct remedy.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: raw wonder without sorting overwhelms judgment. 2) Inference: Song compilation impulse is a cognitive-alchemical act—distill multiplicity into types. 3) Inference: each type implies signature causes and interventions. 4) Inference: cross-type confusion (treating a debt-ghost as a pure romance-fox) fails. 5) Conclusion: BaZi master-work is the same as 广记 work—classify chart phenomena into operative genres before acting.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build a personal typology table: career blocks, health flares, relationship loops mapped to 十神 patterns. 2) When crisis hits, first ask ‘which 广记 category?’ then ‘which useful god?’ 3) Study one category deeply per 大运 phase rather than dabbling. 4) Use encyclopedic humility: rare patterns exist—don’t force every case into favorite theory. 5) Index dreams, omens, and illnesses separately; look for crossover only after pure types are clear.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-author 笔记 with voice and verdict, 太平广记 is imperial archive logic—breadth over persona. Unlike 封神’s unified mythic plot, it refuses one story; its gift to BaZi is classification science.

entries.logic_thesis: Xu Xuan’s records prove a transitional epistemology: early Song still treats spirit reports as politically and personally actionable intelligence, yet with archival sobriety. The argument is that 稽 (‘examine/investigate’) is the proper verb—spirits are not banned or romanticized but audited.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: title itself mandates investigation, not credulity or scoffing. 2) Inference: short entries model minimal sufficient evidence for a claim about the unseen. 3) Inference: many cases tie anomaly to office, travel, and local cult—public coordinates. 4) Inference: examination yields probabilistic guidance, not absolute oracle. 5) Conclusion: BaZi consultation should inherit 稽神 method—investigate, cite, limit claims.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For each forecast, state evidence tier (natal only / natal+event / natal+event+place). 2) Prefer short, testable predictions like 稽神 entries; review hit rate. 3) Investigate local 神 and 煞 of a client’s residence as co-factors. 4) In 官运, treat omens as administrative alerts—verify, then act. 5) Drop narratives that cannot be audited; silence is better than ornate error.
entries.logic_compare: Drier than 玄怪录’s artful strangeness and leaner than 太平广记’s omnibus. It stands closest to professional ethics for diviners: examine spirits as one examines documents.

entries.logic_thesis: Investiture of the Gods proves that history’s slaughter is secretly a staffing process for the celestial bureaucracy: death and defeat are recruitment under a higher table of organization. The core argument is that 命 is an appointment list; cultivation and loyalty determine which office one is ‘封’ into after role-death in the human drama.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Zhou’s rise needs not only arms but a reordered pantheon. 2) Inference: each warrior’s death is dual—military loss and metaphysical posting. 3) Inference: sect affiliation (Chan vs Jie) dramatizes competing cosmologies of inclusion and excess. 4) Inference: broken oaths and cruel techniques produce cursed appointments. 5) Conclusion: BaZi 官杀 and 神煞 are pre-traces of the office one is training for—ethics decide the post’s quality.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read 七杀 as raw commission: with 食神/制, it becomes legitimate 偏官 service; without, massacre destiny. 2) In conflict years, ask ‘what office is this death-of-role creating?’ (career exit as investiture). 3) Avoid 封神-style 左道 techniques (shortcut magic) when 伤官 is hot—cost is later binding. 4) Align vows and team loyalty with 比劫/正官 structure; betrayal patterns match novel’s doomed factions. 5) Use ritual closure after major life ‘battles’ so qi posts correctly rather than wandering as resentful 煞.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 山志’s place-based sanctity, 封神 is personnel cosmology on civilizational scale. Unlike 济公全传’s trickster compassion, it is hierarchical and martial—best for modeling 官杀 hierarchy, not intimate ethics.

entries.logic_thesis: The novel proves that heterodox arts plus social grievance produce ‘妖’ as a political-qi epidemic: magic is real as technique, but without legitimate 正 order it amplifies chaos until systematically dismantled. The argument is diagnostic—identify the technique, the grievance fuel, and the correct team of counter-practitioners (the three Sui).
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: forbidden arts circulate among the desperate and ambitious. 2) Inference: personal grievance is the fire under magical rebellion. 3) Inference: spectacle magic fools crowds by hijacking 食伤/财 attention. 4) Inference: only coordinated, rightly timed counter-skill (not mere force) restores order. 5) Conclusion: BaZi crises that look ‘demonic’ are often technique + fuel + mis-timed response; cure is triad: clarity, timing, ethical force.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When chart shows 伤官 + 偏财 + 劫煞 chaos, audit for ‘heterodox shortcuts’ (scams, cults, stimulant lifestyles). 2) Separate fuel (怨) from technique (巧); heal grievance before fighting symptoms. 3) Build a ‘三遂 team’: one analyst (印), one doer (比劫/食), one ritual/behavioral boundary (官). 4) Time crackdowns on bad habits to 官杀 useful periods, not to 桃花 high. 5) After quelling, reinvest energy into legitimate craft—empty hands refill with 妖 if idle.
entries.logic_compare: More sociological than 封神’s celestial HR; more cautionary than 女仙外史’s sometimes glorified rebellion. For cultivation, it is the manual of anti-left-path hygiene and collective counter-practice.

entries.logic_thesis: Ji Gong’s saga proves that realized mind can wear pollution as camouflage: true function is 游戏三昧—saving beings through apparent violation of form. The argument is that attachment to pure appearance is itself a demon; compassion plus skillful means outranks cosmetic precept.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: late institutional religion confuses robe and realization. 2) Inference: a living arhat may invert signs (wine, meat, madness) to bypass ego of pure and impure. 3) Inference: miracles follow need, not display schedule. 4) Inference: those who cling to surface purity miss the living Buddha and keep their 障. 5) Conclusion: in BaZi/cultivation, useful god operation may look ‘wrong’ to rigid school-forms yet be correct for the chart’s actual 病药.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Identify where your ‘precept’ is actually 印星 vanity; test whether breaking a minor form enables greater 食神 service. 2) Strong 七杀/伤官: channel Ji Gong—disruptive behavior only when it protects beings, never as self-indulgence. 3) Practice 游戏: lightness in 比劫 conflicts reduces 煞. 4) Charity and rescue actions in 财/官 years without branding them as spiritual capital. 5) Teachers: judge by liberation effect, not by costume—apply same to your own public image.
entries.logic_compare: Inverts 封神’s formal pantheon and 阅微’s bureaucratic moralism: holiness as clown. Unlike 南游记’s fierce deity careerism, Ji Gong is downward-mobile compassion—key for charts that must use ‘impure’ careers as 用神.

entries.logic_thesis: Journey to the South proves a deity-career logic: Huaguang’s violent, multi-birth path shows that fierce 火 nature must complete karma through successive role-embodiments before stabilizing as a recognized protector. The argument is developmental—wrath is not deleted but promoted through ordeal into office.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: certain spirits/persons are constitutionally fierce fire. 2) Inference: suppression without transformation only relocates disaster across rebirths/roles. 3) Inference: each episode (conflict with Heaven, descent, redemption) is a promotion exam. 4) Inference: final cult recognition ratifies successful sublimation of wrath into protection. 5) Conclusion: BaZi strong 七杀/伤官/fire is a multi-stage career of the god within—design ordeals as exams, not as random suffering.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map 大运 as Huaguang chapters: outlaw phase → contested phase → protector phase. 2) Never aim to ‘extinguish’ useful 杀; aim to 食神制杀 or 杀印相生 sublimation. 3) Use southern/fire industries carefully as proper temple for such charts. 4) Ritualize apology and repair after wrath episodes—speed promotion to protector role. 5) Avoid premature self-canonization; recognition comes after ordeal completion.
entries.logic_compare: Sibling to 封神’s investiture but focused on one deity’s Bildungsroman of fire. Less comic than 济公, less feminist-rebellious than 女仙外史—pure template for fierce-chart career alchemy.

entries.logic_thesis: This novel proves that dynastic injustice can legitimate a counter-mandate led by feminine immortal power: Tang Sai’er’s uprising is framed as 天道 correcting 人道 when the throne violates cosmic equity. The argument is that yin authority is not secondary; under specific historical-qi conditions it becomes the main corrective axis.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Ming founding violence and misrule create surplus 冤. 2) Inference: surplus seeks a carrier; feminine immortal lineage supplies form. 3) Inference: rebellion is rewritten as eschatological repair, not mere banditry. 4) Inference: literary 外史 asserts truth outside official history’s monopoly. 5) Conclusion: BaZi must allow 阴用神 and ‘unofficial’ paths when official 官 structures are corrupt relative to the chart’s mandate.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For 阴干 useful-god charts (especially 乙己丁癸 strong), do not force purely yang career molds. 2) When 官 is 忌神, ‘外史 path’—independent enterprise, alternative institutions—may be correct 运. 3) Channel grievance into structured 七杀 use with 印/食, not pure 劫财 revolt. 4) Study timing of collective movements only if personal chart has 驿马+杀+义; else cultivate local repair. 5) Honor 女仙 logic: protect the vulnerable as the way yin mandate proves itself.
entries.logic_compare: More politically inverted than 封神’s eventual orthodox Zhou order; more sustained ideological rebellion than 三遂’s anti-妖 quelling. For BaZi, it theorizes legitimate anti-structure when structure is the disease.

entries.logic_thesis: Niu Sengru’s tales prove that the ‘mysterious’ is a narrative technology for testing elite moral imagination: encounters with the strange measure whether the official mind can remain humane under ontological shock. The argument is that 玄 is a training environment for judgment, not a catalog of tricks.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Tang literati subjectivity is the true protagonist. 2) Inference: ghost/immortal plots are simulators for virtue under uncertainty. 3) Inference: aesthetic control of strangeness disciplines fear and desire. 4) Inference: those who respond with ritual correctness plus human warmth pass. 5) Conclusion: BaZi counseling and self-cultivation need 玄怪 capacity—hold unknown variables without collapsing into panic or greed.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In 空亡/华盖 years, practice sitting with uncertainty as 玄 training. 2) When forecasts conflict, keep dual hypotheses like a well-told 怪 tale—update on evidence. 3) Use elegant restraint in speech about destiny (literati craft as 食神). 4) Test moral response to sudden chart-events before optimizing tactics. 5) Read one classical anomaly tale when 七杀 hits—train nervous system on safe strange.
entries.logic_compare: More artful and elite-psychological than 稽神录’s audit prose; less encyclopedic than 太平广记; less Qing-moralist than 阅微. It is cultivation of cognitive poise for diviners and officials.

entries.logic_thesis: Liu Jingshu proves that marvels are local ecology: the ‘garden’ metaphor argues for curated diversity of anomalies as a natural history of the weird. The core claim is that strangeness is regional and species-like—each biome of qi grows characteristic 异.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: Six Dynasties curiosity treats anomaly as collectible natural fact. 2) Inference: arranging marvels as a garden implies typology by habitat. 3) Inference: human fate is partly which garden one lives in (place-species of event). 4) Inference: transplanting without care (wrong move, wrong cult) kills or mutates the pattern. 5) Conclusion: BaZi expressions are habitat-relative; same chart, different 异苑.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When relocating, predict which anomaly/opportunity species the new region favors for your useful gods. 2) Build a ‘garden’ of micro-practices suited to local climate and culture. 3) Do not universalize one region’s ghost/luck lore onto another chart without place adjustment. 4) Collect small verified local patterns as Liu collected 异. 5) Prune toxic marvels (sensational media, fear cults) like weeding the garden.
entries.logic_compare: Earlier, shorter, more natural-historical than Qing 笔记 moral courts; less romantic than 聊斋. Its unique gift is habitat logic—BaZi × regional 风土.

entries.logic_thesis: He Bang’e proves that night conversation is a legitimate epistemic mode: what cannot be certified at noon may still be true as 夜-pattern, when yin faculties dominate. The argument is that timing of knowing matters—some causal structures only disclose under yin conditions.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: title frames knowledge as evening talk, not daylight memorial. 2) Inference: narrative sociality (talk) midwifes spirit truth. 3) Inference: night is when 阴神 and dream logic share continuum with waking residue. 4) Inference: recording night-talks preserves half of human data usually discarded. 5) Conclusion: BaZi must schedule analysis and cultivation across yin–yang hours; exclusive daylight rationalism truncates the chart.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Do dream/journal review in 亥子丑; do contracts and surgery timing logic in yang hours. 2) Strong 水/印 charts: honor night study; strong 火 charts: limit night talk to avoid 耗. 3) Use conversation with trusted peers as 夜谭 method for hard chart puzzles. 4) Track which 流日 branches bring usable night signals. 5) Avoid deciding major yang-world moves solely on nocturnal emotion peaks.
entries.logic_compare: Closer to social storytelling than 阅微’s judgment seat; less polished fame than 聊斋 but clearer about the epistemology of night. It uniquely theorizes when knowledge is valid—critical for 择时.

entries.logic_thesis: Zhang Du’s work, named for the Han hall where Emperor Wen heard Jia Yi on ghosts and spirits, proves that ruler-level policy conversation must include the unseen as risk and resource. The argument is that political rationality incomplete without 神道 data is false thrift of attention.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Premise: historical 宣室 dialogue models elite seriousness about spirits. 2) Inference: Tang tales under that title inherit the duty to advise power about yin causes. 3) Inference: personal stories scale to state analogy—household disorder mirrors realm disorder. 4) Inference: proper hearing (listening without panic or ridicule) is the first ritual of governance. 5) Conclusion: BaZi for leaders and self-leaders is 宣室 practice—hear the invisible factors before issuing orders to life.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before yearly planning, hold a personal 宣室: review omens, health, ethics, and chart 忌神 as cabinet reports. 2) Leaders: treat team ‘ghosts’ (burnout, rumor, silent resentment) as real 阴 factors. 3) Cultivate listening virtue (印) equal to decisive 杀. 4) Separate Jia Yi-style analytic speech about spirits from vulgar fearmongering. 5) After decisions, audit unseen side-effects as Zhang Du’s cases would.
entries.logic_compare: More explicitly political-classical in frame than most 志怪; less comic-folk than 济公, less romantic than 聊斋. It is the template for integrating spirit-causality into high-level timing and governance of one’s fate.
